capabilities: show a floating toolbar near selected text in desktop editors
apply bold, italic, strikethrough, inline code, and highlight formatting
set text and background colors as inline HTML spans
insert internal links with a note picker
pin, reorder, and toggle toolbar actions per vault
extras: Not yet listed in the community directory; must be installed manually from GitHub Releases. Desktop only (requires Obsidian 1.8.7+); mobile and Reading view are unsupported. Free with voluntary donations. Custom colors persist as inline HTML that export tools may strip. The manifest notes it has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian requires using menus, commands, or hotkeys for small formatting tasks; the plugin keeps those actions next to the selected text.
summary: Floating selection toolbar for desktop Obsidian that applies Markdown formatting, text and background colors, and internal links to selected text.
